references.text: Encourages valuing heavenly treasures over earthly ones, similar to how Psalm 49:16-17 speaks of the transience of wealth.
Speaks of an eternal treasure in heaven, corresponding with the idea of storing up treasures in heaven in Matthew.
Refers to a better and lasting inheritance in heaven, parallel to the concept of storing up treasures in heaven.
Mentions an imperishable, undefiled, and unfading inheritance kept in heaven, which resonates with the idea of storing up treasures in heaven.
